title: Mission V1.5 full execution mission amendment and canonical re-registration
description: Create a new byte-frozen V1.5 Mission from the Owner-provided full V1.4 final candidate because V1.4 is already canonically frozen. Register the new exact Mission hash, create the mandatory V1.4-to-V1.5 compatibility proof and amendments registry, preserve V1.4 bytes, require fresh HIGH-risk gates and Owner artifact-bound amendment sign-off, regenerate the Task Catalog, and prohibit Item 10 continuation until this amendment becomes canonical.

why_high: This task changes the canonical Mission specification that governs trusted transport, evidence, authority, merge eligibility, Item 10 and V1 operational acceptance.
The new Mission explicitly requires Owner sign-off for amendments and defines security/Human/TOCTOU invariants used for future production-trust decisions.
Incorrect amendment provenance or compatibility reuse could authorize invalid evidence across Mission versions.
why_not_lower: Documentation-only file type does not reduce governance impact; the Mission is an authority-defining artifact.
The Task Contract deterministically raises mission/amendment paths to HIGH through an explicit task risk rule.

dependencies.name: Mission V1.4 canonical registration and exact-SHA post-merge closure

acceptance_criteria.description: The predecessor V1.4 Mission file remains byte-preserved and unmodified.
The V1.5 Mission contains the full Owner-provided 43-section final candidate with only the mandatory version advance V1.4→V1.5 and top Mission Status set to FROZEN.

The source candidate SHA-256 is 3475a12f4c44a7d19db34308ba2049a8fe5bc1d6cd08e31051a7be66e9c2eae3 and the exact V1.5 Mission SHA-256 is 7b29943c936592b63ae76a67359a0cae1b3dd99b2323f1811bc7b2e3d03317a1; the Mission does not embed its own hash.
REGISTRY.md registers V1.5 with seconds-precision UTC, exact file name, exact hash and frozen-on-canonical-completion semantics while preserving V1.4 history.
AMENDMENTS-REGISTRY.md and the V1.4→V1.5 Compatibility Proof exist and explicitly reject acceptance-test evidence reuse.
Tests 1–7 are all marked AFFECTED and MUST run under V1.5; only immutable Stage A provider facts may be historically referenced.
The generated Task Catalog includes MA-MISSION-V1-5-AMENDMENT-001 and indexes 38 Task Contracts exactly.
Effective risk is HIGH and deterministic task risk rules prevent downgrade below HIGH for the mission/amendment paths.
Exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, artifact-bound Review, Security and ACTIVE Lock all pass before HUMAN_PENDING.
Owner Amendment Sign-off occurs only in HUMAN_PENDING and binds exact Task ID, Head SHA, Artifact Hash and verified owner login rahemih.
After Human approval, TOCTOU revalidation proves head/base/hash/CI/Review/Security/Lock/Protection/Human binding are still valid and Merge Policy has zero blockers.
V1.5 becomes canonical FROZEN only after protected workflow merge and exact-SHA post-merge canonical plus Phase A verification pass.
Item 10 implementation remains blocked until V1.5 is canonical and B1 resolves an executable canonical Item 10 specification.

external_gate_evidence.rule: HIGH Mission amendment requires exact-artifact REVIEW PASS, SECURITY PASS, ACTIVE LOCK and authorized Owner HUMAN APPROVED. Any mutation stales all artifact-bound gates.
